title: Mediterranean Gratin Courgettes
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make side dish that combines the sweetness of courgettes with the savory flavors of the Mediterranean.
instructions: Grate the courgettes and place them in a colander. Sprinkle with salt to draw out excess moisture.
Let the courgettes sit for 10 minutes, then squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the grated courgettes to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the courgettes to a baking dish and drizzle with lemon juice.
Sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese over the top of the courgettes.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
